name: Apache — High-Volume 4xx Recon Scanning From Single Client
xql_query:
datamodel dataset = apache_httpd_raw
| alter status = to_integer(xdm.network.http.response_code),
        uri = xdm.network.http.url,
        ua = xdm.source.user_agent,
        method = xdm.network.http.method
| filter xdm.source.ipv4 != null and status >= 400
| filter uri contains "/admin"
       or uri contains "/login"
       or uri contains "/wp-"
       or uri contains "/phpmyadmin"
       or uri contains "/.env"
       or uri contains "/.git"
       or uri contains "/config"
       or uri contains "/backup"
       or uri contains "/console"
       or uri contains "/.aws"
       or uri contains "/actuator"
| bin _time span = 30m
| comp count() as recon_4xx,
       count_distinct(uri) as distinct_paths,
       values(uri) as scanned_paths,
       values(ua) as user_agents,
       values(method) as methods,
       values(status) as response_codes,
       values(xdm.target.ipv4) as tgt_ips
       by xdm.source.ipv4, _time
| filter recon_4xx >= 50 and distinct_paths >= 15
| fields xdm.source.ipv4, tgt_ips, scanned_paths, user_agents, response_codes
description: Apache httpd showing ≥20 HTTP 4xx responses from a single client IP within one hour — vulnerability scanning or directory traversal recon.
alert_name: Apache — High-Volume 4xx Recon Scanning From Single Client
